findings.message: The ticket-changed check compares only the Git blob and checkout bytes. An accepted database revision held before export can leave both unchanged, so the check must consult the service to invalidate the pinned revision.
findings.paved_road: Fence the stage change check and its affected tests, and require it to compare the pinned revision with service state.

findings.message: Author publication independently writes and commits ticket revisions, leaving a live ticket writer outside the service after the port.
findings.paved_road: Fence author publication and its affected tests, and route its ticket revisions through the service or explicitly define a coordinated exception.

findings.message: This test requires intake itself to stamp and commit the ticket under the existing Git locks, which conflicts with replacing that writer with the service exporter.
findings.paved_road: Fence and update the test for the service-owned transaction and checkpoint boundary.

findings.message: This test requires intake to commit ticket and evidence paths together, conflicting with the ticket-only checkpoint requirement and service-owned writer.
findings.paved_road: Specify evidence publication semantics and fence the affected intake tests.

findings.message: This test invokes the old intake writer and requires its commit to include evidence alongside ticket.md.
findings.paved_road: Fence and update the test after defining evidence publication through the service.

findings.message: This test requires verdict handling to write ticket bytes directly inside runner's Git commit callback, contradicting the service-owned revision writer.
findings.paved_road: Fence and update the test to exercise verdict submission and service-owned checkpointing.

findings.message: The ticket requires checkpoints to contain only ticket.md but does not define how intake preserves its existing publication of required evidence files before dispatch.
findings.paved_road: Specify an evidence publication and recovery contract compatible with ticket-only checkpoints, and fence its implementation and affected tests.
